item.title: Glen Hansard’s Family Announces Public Memorial and Funeral Details in Dublin
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to our podcast, where we're sharing the latest news and updates. Today, we're remembering the life of Irish singer-songwriter Glen Hansard, who passed away on July 29th at the age of 56. His family has announced details of his public memorial and funeral, and we're here to share those with you."
[Soft music transitions in]
Host: "A public wake for Glen Hansard will be held at the Baroque Chapel at IMMA, Royal Hospital Kilmainham in Dublin on Monday, August 3rd, from 11 am to 4 pm. This will be an opportunity for fans to pay their respects to the beloved musician."
[Short pause]
Host: "The following day, Tuesday, August 4th, a funeral service will take place at St. Patrick's Cathedral in Dublin at 1:30 pm. While the service is open to the public, access inside the cathedral will be limited due to the large number of mourners expected. For those who can't attend in person, the funeral will be broadcast live on Irish news outlets RTE News and RIP.IE."
[Soft music continues]
Host: "Glen's family has also shared that music at the funeral will be provided by his friends and family, making it a truly special celebration of his life. In lieu of flowers and gifts, they're asking well-wishers to consider donating to Dublin's Simon Community or Ukrainian Action."
[Short pause]
Host: "As we remember Glen Hansard's life and legacy, we're also hearing from fellow artists who've been touched by his music. Bono, Bruce Springsteen, Billie Eilish, and Lin-Manuel Miranda are just a few of the many who've shared their condolences and memories of Glen."
[Closing music starts]
Host: "We'll continue to celebrate Glen Hansard's life and music in the days to come. For now, our thoughts are with his family and loved ones. Thank you for joining us today."
[Outro music plays]
